title: security(data): credential-class field values reach record-change consumers (event payloads and the records downstream features keep from them) unmasked — detail withheld pending maintainer
body:
Found while reviewing #21816 (the fix for #21787, credential-class masking on write responses), by the independent security review the PM seat ran on it. #21816 closes the request/response half; this card is the other half of the same class.

- **Class:** authorization (a disclosure across a permission boundary). Credential-class field values that reads and write responses mask are carried unmasked into the record-change channel, and from there into data that some downstream features store or forward and that users below the write boundary can read.
- **Reach, by class:** a stored snapshot readable by non-privileged participants of a workflow (the most concrete); an outbound delivery and its stored log, readable by organization administrators; a conditional search index. In-process realtime is not externally reachable; the audit trail already masks.
- **Detail:** under RUNNER rule 2 the reproduction, the consumers by name and the mechanism are **withheld pending maintainer**. They are held in the PM session (Claude Code session `session_018zT8d8NpiQ1ExhuNd5TxY6`) and reported to the maintainer there.
- **Severity as judged by the reviewer:** medium to high.
- **Not a 17.7 regression:** the code involved predates 17.6.0.
- **Direction:** apply the same credential mask (and internal-field omission) where record-change payloads are produced, plus the stored-snapshot and index producers as defence in depth. No boundary moves, so this is not a decision card.
- **Owning repo:** `objectstack`. Related: #21787, #21816. No existing card covers it (open issues searched).
